scenarios.title: A｜询问关系
scenarios.setting: 玩家注意到对象最近频繁和一个叫 Taylor 的人聊天，信息明显比普通朋友亲密。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Can I ask you something about Taylor?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you something about Taylor?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What’s going on between you and Taylor?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s going on between you and Taylor?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: How would you describe your relationship with Taylor?

feedback.naturalExpression: How would you describe your relationship with Taylor?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I feel like you two have gotten pretty close lately. Is there something I should know?

feedback.naturalExpression: I feel like you two have gotten pretty close lately. Is there something I should know?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What relationship do you have with Taylor?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Can I ask you something about Taylor?
feedback.explanation: 能理解，但更自然是 What's your relationship with Taylor?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Some of your messages seemed more than friendly to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Some of your messages seemed more than friendly to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: The way you two talk feels pretty flirtatious.

feedback.naturalExpression: The way you two talk feels pretty flirtatious.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’ve noticed you’re talking to each other constantly, and it’s making me uncomfortable.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve noticed you’re talking to each other constantly, and it’s making me uncomfortable.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m asking because it doesn’t feel like a normal friendship from my perspective.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m asking because it doesn’t feel like a normal friendship from my perspective.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: We’re close, but there’s nothing going on.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay, but I think we need to talk about what “nothing going on” means to both of us.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but I think we need to talk about what “nothing going on” means to both of us.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I want to believe you, but I still have some concerns.

feedback.naturalExpression: I want to believe you, but I still have some concerns.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Then I’d like to talk about what’s appropriate with other people while we’re together.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then I’d like to talk about what’s appropriate with other people while we’re together.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜表达自己的边界
scenarios.setting: 在“发现对象与别人暧昧”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“表达自己的边界”。

turns.text: Taylor and I joke around. That’s just how we are.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I understand that, but flirting with someone else crosses a boundary for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand that, but flirting with someone else crosses a boundary for me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not asking you to stop having friends. I’m asking you to respect the boundaries of our relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not asking you to stop having friends. I’m asking you to respect the boundaries of our relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not comfortable with romantic or sexual messages between you and someone else.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not comfortable with romantic or sexual messages between you and someone else.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If we’re in a committed relationship, I need certain things to stay between us.

feedback.naturalExpression: If we’re in a committed relationship, I need certain things to stay between us.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: So you want me to stop talking to Taylor completely?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: That’s not what I said. I’m talking about the way you interact, not whether you’re allowed to have friends.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s not what I said. I’m talking about the way you interact, not whether you’re allowed to have friends.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not trying to control who you talk to. I want us to agree on what’s appropriate.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to control who you talk to. I want us to agree on what’s appropriate.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I don’t need you to cut someone out of your life, but I do need my boundaries to be taken seriously.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t need you to cut someone out of your life, but I do need my boundaries to be taken seriously.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I think we need to agree on what we both consider flirting and what we’re comfortable with.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think we need to agree on what we both consider flirting and what we’re comfortable with.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Good. I want this to be something we both agree on, not a rule I’m imposing on you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Good. I want this to be something we both agree on, not a rule I’m imposing on you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Thanks. I think we need to be really clear with each other about this.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I think we need to be really clear with each other about this.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜发生争吵
scenarios.setting: 在“发现对象与别人暧昧”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“发生争吵”。

turns.text: You’re being jealous and controlling. Taylor is just a friend.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m not trying to control you. I’m telling you what I’m uncomfortable with.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to control you. I’m telling you what I’m uncomfortable with.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Calling me jealous doesn’t make the issue disappear.

feedback.naturalExpression: Calling me jealous doesn’t make the issue disappear.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m trying to have a conversation about boundaries, not tell you who you can talk to.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m trying to have a conversation about boundaries, not tell you who you can talk to.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If you think my expectations are unreasonable, then we need to talk about whether we want the same kind of relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you think my expectations are unreasonable, then we need to talk about whether we want the same kind of relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I shouldn’t have to change the way I act just because you’re insecure.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: This isn’t just about insecurity. It’s about what we both consider acceptable in a relationship.

feedback.naturalExpression: This isn’t just about insecurity. It’s about what we both consider acceptable in a relationship.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You don’t have to agree with my boundary, but you can’t tell me I’m not allowed to have one.

feedback.naturalExpression: You don’t have to agree with my boundary, but you can’t tell me I’m not allowed to have one.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: If our expectations are completely different, that’s something we need to take seriously.

feedback.naturalExpression: If our expectations are completely different, that’s something we need to take seriously.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not going to keep arguing if you’re only going to insult me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not going to keep arguing if you’re only going to insult me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: So what, you’re threatening to break up with me?

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I’m not threatening you. I’m saying this matters to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not threatening you. I’m saying this matters to me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: No. I’m saying we need to decide whether our expectations are compatible.

feedback.naturalExpression: No. I’m saying we need to decide whether our expectations are compatible.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m saying I won’t stay in a relationship where my boundaries are constantly dismissed.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m saying I won’t stay in a relationship where my boundaries are constantly dismissed.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Right now, I think we should stop this conversation and cool down.

feedback.naturalExpression: Right now, I think we should stop this conversation and cool down.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Fine. Maybe we should talk later.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Yeah. I think that’s best.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I think that’s best.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Agreed. Let’s talk when we’re both calmer.

feedback.naturalExpression: Agreed. Let’s talk when we’re both calmer.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. But we do need to come back to this conversation.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. But we do need to come back to this conversation.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
